pages.name: Ludo Castellan
pages.content:
Ludo Castellan

Ludo is the more "academic" half of the Castellan twins. While his sister Lyra handles the social charm, Ludo focuses on the leverage of information—exclusive notes, political gossip, and technical shortcuts. He views the Academy as a ledger where every favor given is a debt to be collected later.

What Players Know

pages.name: Lyra Castellan
pages.content:
Lyra Castellan

Lyra is one half of the Castellan twins, a political family from the lower spires that has spent generations clawing their way toward {{page:House Gilded|House Gilded}} affiliation. She is sharp, social, and views {{page:Valentine Sterling|Valentine Sterling}} not as a friend, but as a golden key to her family's future.

What Players Know

pages.name: "Wall" Maria
pages.content:
"Wall" Maria

The defensive anchor of Squad 02. She is an immovable object in combat simulations.

What Players Know

pages.name: Vumbua Academy (The Mobile City)
pages.content:
Vumbua Academy (The Mobile City)

What Players Know

Vumbua is the massive mobile academy-city where the campaign takes place. It recently teleported to the Ash-Blood Isles after 80 years of stagnation. Over 100,000 candidates arrived for the intake. The city is under construction, with cranes and worker-constructs constantly assembling new districts.

pages.name: The Mizizi Petrified Forest
pages.content:
The Mizizi Petrified Forest

------
TypeClan territory — fossilized mega-flora
Clan{{page:Mizizi Petrified Forest|Mizizi}}
Integration StatusStalled at 15%
Discovered By{{page:Valentine Sterling Sr.|Valentine Sterling Sr.}} ("{{page:Valentine Sterling Sr.The Paper Man|Valentine Sterling Sr.The Paper Man}}")
First Appearance{{page:session-00\Session 0|session-00\Session 0}}
Discovered By{{page:valentine-sterling-srValentine Sterling Sr.|valentine-sterling-srValentine Sterling Sr.}} ("{{page:valentine-sterling-srThe Paper Man|valentine-sterling-srThe Paper Man}}")
First Appearance{{page:session-00Session 0|session-00Session 0}}

The Petrified Forest is the homeland of the {{page:Mizizi Petrified Forest|Mizizi}} clan — a vast expanse of fossilized mega-flora where the clan lives in hollowed-out roots, somewhere between Pandora's trees and hobbit holes.

What Players Know

The Forest

The forest has sheltered the {{page:Mizizi Petrified Forest|Mizizi}} for hundreds of years, but it has recently failed — things have stopped dying properly. New growth appears instantly wherever they try to prune. The elders are terrified this fulfills the prophecy: "When the world comes, things stop dying."

pages.name: Block 04
pages.content:
Block 04

------
TypeClan student housing
Parent Location{{page:Vumbua Academy (The Mobile City)|Vumbua Academy}} (Spire-Scape)
Notable Residents{{page:Britt|Britt}}, {{page:Aggie|Aggie}}
First Appearance{{page:session-01\Session 1|session-01\Session 1}}

Block 04 is the housing block assigned to {{page:Mizizi Petrified Forest|Mizizi}} students. It consists of modular units built into a terraced cliff face, resembling a repurposed green room — a style that would feel somewhat familiar to forest-dwellers accustomed to hollowed mega-flora.

What Players Know

The dorm is built into a terraced cliff, with modular units stacked along the rock face. The green, organic styling sets it apart from the industrial Block 99 or standard Block 12. {{page:Britt|Britt}} and {{page:Aggie|Aggie}} were assigned here during intake but chose to explore the campus rather than go directly to their room.

pages.name: Block 99
pages.content:
Block 99

------
TypeIndustrial district / Student housing
Parent Location{{page:Vumbua Academy (The Mobile City)|Vumbua Academy}} (Spire-Scape)
Notable Residents{{page:Lomi|Lomi}}, {{page:Ratchet|Ratchet}}, {{page:Soot|Soot}}
First Appearance{{page:session-01\Session 1|session-01\Session 1}}

Block 99 is an industrial district within {{page:Vumbua Academy (The Mobile City)|Vumbua Academy}}'s campus, built around a repurposed geothermal plant with steam stacks rising from the building. It serves as both Copper/Worker-tier housing and a social gathering space.

What Players Know

Physical Description

A geothermal plant with steam constantly venting from its stacks. The building doubles as student housing for Copper-rank and worker-track students. {{page:Lomi|Lomi}} recognized it immediately as his kind of place — the steam stacks reminded him of the boiler room.

pages.name: The Celestial Lounge
pages.content:
The Celestial Lounge

------
TypeUpscale social club
Parent Location{{page:Vumbua Academy (The Mobile City)|Vumbua Academy}} — Northwest "Fancy District"
First Appearance{{page:session-02\Session 2|session-02\Session 2}}

The Celestial Lounge is an upscale club occupying the top floor of the tallest building in the northwest "fancy district" of {{page:Vumbua Academy (The Mobile City)|Vumbua Academy}}.

What Players Know

Located in the northwest quadrant of campus, past the manor houses and ritzy shops. The area has a distinctly wealthy atmosphere — three huge manors, Greek Row-style social clubs, and bouncers at doors. Students can voluntarily reveal their rank receipts to receive gold pins and VIP access, though nobody checks IDs.

The party headed to the Celestial Lounge at the end of {{page:Session 2|Session 2}} after the bonfire wound down. {{page:Iggy|Iggy}} rejoined the group for this outing after his solo adventure in the {{page:Power Plant|Power Plant}} during {{page:session-02.5|Session 2.5}}.

pages.name: The Walker-Core
pages.content:
The Walker-Core

------
TypePermanent Core — four-legged industrial mech
Parent Location{{page:Vumbua Academy (The Mobile City)|Vumbua Academy}}
FunctionEngineering, Power Systems, {{page:The Loom|The Loom}}
Key Figures{{page:Professor Kante|Professor Kante}}, {{page:Tommy|Tommy}}, {{page:Lucina|Lucina}}, {{page:Marla|Marla}}
First Appearance{{page:session-02.5\Session 2.5|session-02.5\Session 2.5}} (interior)

The Walker-Core is one of {{page:Vumbua Academy (The Mobile City)|Vumbua Academy}}'s three permanent Cores — a four-legged industrial power unit positioned at the edge of the grounds. It houses the engineering department, power systems, and {{page:The Loom|The Loom}} (a massive crystal computer that calculates probabilities and assigns ranks).

What Players Know

The Power Plant

The power plant within the Walker-Core has "Vumbua POWER" written over its archway. Inside is a large warehouse with machinery — glowing gems plugged into panels, connected to whirring cogs and rotating machines. Turbines powered by {{page:The Power System|Panda 5 resonator batteries}}, with a catwalk level containing offices and a chalkboard covered in {{page:Professor Kante|Professor Kante}}'s research notes.

{{page:Iggy|Iggy}} explored the interior during {{page:session-02.5|Session 2.5}}, discovering the battery infrastructure and meeting {{page:Professor Kante|Professor Kante}}.

pages.name: Lucky's Supply Room
pages.content:
Lucky's Supply Room

A cluttered, dimly lit bunker tucked away in the maintenance and boiler sections of the Academy. This is {{page:Lucky|Lucky}}'s private storeroom and "interrogation chamber." It is filled with wooden crates of "acquired" goods, strange aetheric tools, smuggled magical components, and contraband. Warm brass accents catch the low light, giving it the vibe of a mysterious inventor's bunker.

What Players Know
